findings.claim: The relocation inventory and the dependency-direction gap omit two crates that sovereign-sync depends on by path (learner-model, skill-index), so the G1 ownership boundary and the analyze-stage move list will be wrong.
findings.evidence: substrate/sovereign-sync/Cargo.toml:70-73 declares storage-provider, kbd-runtime, learner-model, prometheus-skill-index path deps (kbd-mobile as dev-dep at line 80). Neither learner-model nor skill-index appears in the sizing note, the inventory, or spec gap 7.
findings.suggested_fix: Compute the full Cargo dependency closure of sovereign-sync and prometheus-cli; add disposition rows for learner-model and skill-index; gap 7 must cover every path dep.
